title: The recorded conflicts
description: workareas/<workarea>/distil/conflicts.json: every disagreement between sources, and every gap that matters, with how it was settled. Written by the reconcile agent beside requirements.json. Never blocking: precedence settles what it can, and every question carries a default so building can start. `tim distil coverage` validates it against this file, and also checks what a schema cannot: ids are unique, every position names a source in sources.json and a claim some extract or verification holds, every conflict is cited by at least one requirement, a precedence conflict has positions from at least two sources, and what it overrules is one of its positions, ranked below a position it keeps.

text.description: Text that is not empty or only whitespace.

position.description: What one source says about the conflict.

says.description: The source's position, in one sentence.

claim.description: The claim id the position rests on.

conflict.description: One disagreement or gap. One conflict per decision: never one question copied onto many requirements.

id.description: `c-NNN`. Stable: never renumber, because requirements, increments and the report cite it.

about.description: What is in dispute, in one line.

positions.description: Each source's position, at least one.

resolution.description: precedence: two or more sources disagree, sources.json's precedence settled it, and the higher-ranked source won. Positions all from one source are never settled by precedence: merge their claims into one requirement, or make it a question. question: precedence cannot settle it, or it is a gap that matters, so it goes to Sam with a default.

overruled.description: For precedence only: the claim ids the outcome sets aside, each one a position's claim. List every claim the losing positions rest on that must no longer be built, such as an earlier ruling a later one withdraws. `tim distil coverage` then refuses an adopted or question requirement that still cites one, and a todo or blocked backlog row that still names one. A question overrules nothing until it is answered.

question.description: For a question only: the question for Sam, in one sentence.

default.description: For a question only: what will be built if nobody answers.

then.description: A question carries the question and the default that will be built.

else.description: Precedence settled it, so there is no question and no default.
